description: Lookalike characters that can appear in domain names: pairs from the confusable-vision release named below that pass its suggested thresholds and whose characters can both be registered at a common TLD. Measured by RaySpace at the size and baseline position each glyph has in running text; see the release's DATASET.md.
license: CC-BY-4.0. Attribution: confusable-vision, Paul Wood FRSA (@paultendo).

selection.rule: Within one font: alike in at least 3 text fonts (or all of them, if fewer render both) and at least 5% of the text fonts rendering both. Across fonts: alike in at least 3 font combinations and at least 10% of them. Both characters registrable at a common TLD ("registrableAt").
